name: Irvine Spectrum Center
description: Irvine Spectrum Center is Southern California's premier open-air lifestyle destination featuring over 130 stores and restaurants, highlighted by attractions including a Giant Wheel, carousel, and seasonal ice rink. This iconic entertainment and shopping hub offers a dynamic mix of upscale retail, diverse dining from quick-service to full-service restaurants, and year-round events that create a vibrant community gathering place. Celebrating 30 years of service, the center combines premier shopping with entertainment experiences in an outdoor setting that captures the essence of Orange County lifestyle.
demographics: Affluent families and young professionals in Orange County seeking upscale retail, dining, and entertainment experiences
summary: A celebrated open-air lifestyle center offering 130+ stores, diverse dining, and iconic entertainment attractions including a Giant Wheel and seasonal events in the heart of Orange County.
